reviewCoverage: All 333 original pages were actually inspected in 17 contact sheets. All detected question table candidates were separately inspected at larger crop scale, with individual full-page follow-up for omissions and new figures.
limits: Original source photographs and charts remain about 72 dpi; no new image detail is invented.
Source numerical/unit inconsistencies are preserved verbatim and noted in individual tables rather than silently corrected.
No excluded questions, new rationale-only images, stem screenshots, choice screenshots, external images, new content, question bank edits or teaching edits are included.

Some existing assets select partial figure masks. Complete original inputs are proposed with supersedesFigureIds so the root can prefer complete inputs without deleting original assets or changing rationale mappings.
